question: Should this stale `google-antigravity-auth` cleanup stay limited to current shared stale-plugin surfaces, or should doctor also delete persisted install/load-path state for this removed plugin?
rationale: Current main already repairs stale plugin entries, allow/deny lists, slots, and channels through the shared helper; deleting installs/load paths is broader persisted config cleanup and needs maintainer ownership before merge.

options.title: Narrow and Rebase
options.body: Move any still-needed cleanup into the shared stale-plugin repair helper and leave install/load-path pruning out unless a separate proof-backed follow-up is approved.

options.title: Accept Broader Pruning
options.body: Keep install/load-path deletion only with explicit live upgraded-host proof and maintainer acceptance of the persisted-state cleanup semantics.

options.title: Pause as Mostly Covered
options.body: Leave this branch unmerged if current main's generic stale-plugin cleanup is enough for the original warning path.

recommendation.title: Narrow and Rebase
recommendation.body: Move any still-needed cleanup into the shared stale-plugin repair helper and leave install/load-path pruning out unless a separate proof-backed follow-up is approved.
